correctness.rationale: The exact defining-set code C_D1 is evaluation of Tr_27/3(ax)+b on F27\F3, with F27=F3[X]/(X³+2X+1). Verified modulus has no F3 root, the trace realization, 24 coordinates and rank-four linear message map. An independently written RREF generator enumerated exactly 40+130+40+1=211 nonzero message subspaces (one per linear subcode), computed each union of codeword supports from basis vectors and recovered N1={15:8,16:27,18:4,24:1}; N2={21:80,22:36,24:14}; N3={23:24,24:16}; N4={24:1}. These all add to the Gaussian binomial counts and have minima (15,21,23,24), matching the primary article Examples 3.4/3.8. This is exhaustive over this finite-dimensional code; no uniform family generalization inferred.
residual_risks: Only the exact 24-coordinate affine-slice defining set; other inequivalent ternary [24,4,15] codes may have different subcode spectra.
